verdict.rationale: Mesh documents a per-customer endpoint for setting a customer's monitoring configuration, backed by a dedicated 'Monitor and unmonitor customers' permission. A companion endpoint returns each customer's current monitor status, so ongoing screening can be turned on or off for individual customers. Ongoing monitoring alerts then feed case management. Missing for 10: evidence of a web-app toggle usable by a non-developer compliance officer, bulk enable/disable for a selected group of customers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
